{{CharInfobox| color={{water color}} | corecolor={{water color light}} | bordercolor={{water color dark}} | name=Dock | jname=ツガ | tmname=Tsuga | slogan=no | image=Stern and Dock.png | caption=Dock (right) and Captain Stern in Pokémon Adventures | age=no | gender=Male | colors=no | hometown=Unknown | region=[[Hoenn]] | trainer=no | game=yes | generation={{Gen|III}}, {{Gen|VI}} | games={{game3|Ruby and Sapphire|Ruby, Sapphire|s}}, {{v2|Emerald}}, {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby, Alpha Sapphire}} | leader=no | manga=Adventures | }} '''Dock''' (Japanese: '''ツガ''' ''Tsuga'') is a character in {{game2|Ruby|Sapphire|Emerald}} and {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} who plays a minor role in the story. He works at [[Stern's Shipyard]] and was commissioned to design a ferry. ==In the core series games== [[File:Emerald Dock.png|thumb|left|Dock in Pokémon Emerald]] Before arriving in [[Slateport City]], the player is told by [[Mr. Stone]]'s assistant to deliver a package to [[Captain Stern]] in Slateport. However, Stern is inaccessible until the player talks to Dock. After doing that, the [[Team Magma]]{{sup/3|R}}{{sup/6|OR}}/[[Team Aqua|Aqua]]{{sup/3|S}}{{sup/3|E}}{{sup/6|AS}} [[Grunt]]s, previously preventing the player from entering the [[Oceanic Museum]] (where Captain Stern is), are no longer blocking it off. From that point, the player can advance farther in the game. Much later in the storyline, [[Mr. Briney]] decides to help with the work on the ferry, and Dock notifies the player when they talk to him. In {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}}, it is revealed that Dock used to be a member of the [[Sea Mauville]] Project which eventually failed. Captain Stern reached out to him, however, to join his crew in Slateport, much to his gratitude. {{left clear}} ===Quotes=== ===={{game2|Ruby|Sapphire|Emerald}}==== ; [[Stern's Shipyard]] * Before talking to Captain Stern : ''"Umm… If this goes here, and that goes over there… Then where does this thing go? And what about that doohickey? Aaargh! I can't make heads or tails of this! Hm? Hi, I'm Dock. [[Captain Stern|Capt. Stern]] commissioned me to design a ferry. Oh! That there… Are they [[Devon Parts|Devon Goods]]? But, hmm… This won't do… Capt. Stern went off somewhere. He said he had some work to do. Could I get you to go find Capt. Stern and deliver that to him?"'' : ''"Where could Capt. Stern have gone off to? Could you go find Capt. Stern and deliver that parcel to him?"'' * After talking to Captain Stern : ''"Shipbuilding is an art. A lot of things can't be figured out just by calculating. I really could use advice from a veteran who knows the seas…"'' * After obtaining the Balance Badge : ''"Hi! Mr. Briney's joined us to lend us his help. Thanks to the veteran sailor, the ferry is steadily coming together."'' * After becoming the Champion : ''"The ferry is finally ready! The new S.S. Tidal is truly a marvel of technology! You know, there's never an end to technology's march."'' ====[[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Special Demo Version]]==== ;[[Mossdeep City]] :''"Umm, if this goes here, and that goes over there... {{color2|000|Pokémon Emerald Version|Emerald}} |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}==== Dock (known as '''Tuga''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation) first appears in ''[[PS200|Tripped Up by Torkoal]]'', being forced by the [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] to use the [[Berry Blender]] with [[Captain Stern]] and {{adv|Ruby}}. [[Team Magma]] spotted them and they were taken hostage in order to make Captain Stern give information on the [[Submarine Explorer 1]] project. He suffered from breathing issues due to the smoke from [[Blaise]]'s {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. He and Captain Stern remained in Slateport when [[Kyogre]]'s influence in the area caused much of the city to flood. After the crisis is resolved, Dock, alongside Captain Stern and the Pokémon Fan Club Chairman were finally cured of their illness. ===={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}==== He appears in ''[[PS605|Swampert Smashes]]'', where he and Captain Stern were seen watching the news about the [[Grand Meteor Delta|meteor]] that was about to hit the planet in several days. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{water color}}; border:3px solid #{{water color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{water color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{water color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{water color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | ツガ ''Tsuga'' | From 栂 ''tsuga'' ({{wp|Tsuga sieboldii|Japanese hemlock}}) and 津 ''tsu'' (port) |- | rowspan="2" | English | Dock | From ''dock'' |- style="background:#FFF" | Tuga[[Pokémon Adventures]] ([[Chuang Yi]]) | Similar to his Japanese name |- | German | Bootmar | From ''Boot'' (boat) |- | European Spanish | Muéllez | From ''muelle'' (pier) |- | French | Archibald | From ''architecte'' (architect) |- | Italian | Timon | From ''timone'' ({{wp|rudder}}) |- | Korean | 솔방울 ''Solbang-ul'' | From 솔방울 ''solbang-ul'' ({{wp|Conifer cone|pine cone}}) |- | Chinese (Taiwan) | 都賀 ''Dūhè''Pokémon Adventures | rowspan="2" | From the Japanese name 都賀 ''Tsuga'' |- | Chinese (Hong Kong) | 都賀 ''Dōuhoh'' |- | Chinese (mainland China) | 津贺 ''Jīnhè''Pokémon Adventures (Shanghai VIZ)
